title.narrative: With technical support from UNICEF, Tanzania developed the HIV Response Sustainability Roadmap to ensure adequate and sustainable financing for HIV/AIDS programming. The Global Alliance initiative to end AIDS in children was fully domesticated on its governance and coordination structures strengthened. Global Alliance progress report demonstrated improvements in HIV treatment coverage.
Extent of policies and services for elimination of dual mother-to-child transmission of HIV and syphilis
Existence of improved digital data visualization system CTC3 and DHIS2 disaggregated by age and sex with score card for measuring progress in 28 UNICEF supported districts in mainland, Text
Existence of an updated national guidelines with integrated HIV services and primary health care services and implemented, Text
